Modelled, not measured · 2026 Local Government Elections

Where would Gauteng's voting queues build up?

A queue model for 526 wards and 2,836 voting districts (each voting district is the area served by one voting station), built from the IEC's published results and calibrated to the HSRC's 2026 voter survey. It shows relative pressure on voting stations. It does not report actual waiting times.

–of Gauteng voters modelled to wait over an hour at baseline capacity
–wait over an hour if station capacity drops by 15%
–wait over an hour with 20% more capacity

Analysis by Antonie Peens. Sources: Electoral Commission of South Africa (IEC) 2026 LGE results and voting-district boundaries; HSRC Election Satisfaction Survey 2026, as reported by SAnews (6 November 2026).

All waiting times on this page are model outputs for comparison between areas. They are not measurements and should not be quoted as what voters experienced.
